Market today: The mood for tech/AI is cautious. JPMorgan warns against an AI rebound, and macro concerns like the US deficit and high Treasury yields are headwinds for growth stocks, directly impacting your concentrated portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down over 50% and a leveraged SELL. MUU and SPAL are also leveraged SELLs with significant losses. SMCI is a SELL, nearing its stop. Remember, trading on margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged tech ETFs and SMCI's price action relative to its stop. Also, monitor macro data and any further news on the AI sector.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater and leveraged positions in this uncertain tech environment.
plays: SOXL is down 50% and a SELL. Its stop at 200 is ineffective. Consider a hard trim or exit to cut losses and reduce leveraged exposure.
SMCI is a SELL at 35.78, near its stop of 37.3. Be ready to exit if it crosses the stop to manage further downside.
No new buys today - hold and watch. JPMorgan's warning on AI and general market uncertainty suggest caution over adding new tech positions.
